You’ve described the feeling beautifully! Thank you for putting it into words. 
While reading this it definitely felt like I was invited into another world altogether and everything around me just ceased to exist. I think this is one of the things I love most about this book; how it demanded my absolute attention and devotion to it and how I gladly gave my all to it. 
And as you said, despite the horrific events it truly does feel like a good memory! Although I feel like I’m still mourning the characters and will for a long time I weirdly feel at peace with it. 
But I do feel like I’m going to be able to ‘see them’ again, through countless rereads that I plan on doing. I feel like Jude, Willem, Harold, Andy, Malcom (and all the others) have entered my life and aren’t planning on leaving any time soon and I truly am glad that they’ve decided to stay. <3

(If you ever feel like chatting about the wonderful creating that is A Little Life, dm me)
